paragraphs: My name is Jose, I'm a Software Engineer and I deeply value efficiency and time. That drive is what made me choose this career: it lets me automate processes both for myself and for other people. I'm also passionate about building new solutions through code, turning ideas into useful products.
That interest led me to cloud architecture: designing systems that scale on their own, ship through infrastructure as code and use AI as part of the product, not as decoration.
Along the way I've taken part in hackathons, startup competitions, mentored other students and built personal projects. Those programs taught me a lot and sharpened my competitive side.
